full_judgment:
Kazi Ebadoth Hossain, J: By this application under Article 102(2) of the Constitution, the petitioner has challenged the impugned letter vide Memo No. 38.01.143.011.019.2003-73 dated 18.04.2016 issued by the respondent No. 3, consequent upon which the instant Rule was issued in the following terms: 

 "Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned letter vide Memo No. 38.01.143.011.019.2003-73 dated 18.04.2016 issued by the respondent no. 3 to the petitioner under the heading “বিষয়: সরকারী প্রাথমিক শিক্ষার জন্য সৃষ্ট ‘সহকারী শিক্ষক নিয়োগ ২০১৪’ সুনামগঞ্জ জেলার শাল্লা উপজেলার প্রার্থী জনাব নিহার রঞ্জন দাশ, রোল-২০২৯৮ এর ‘সহকারী শিক্ষক’ পদে নির্বাচন বাতিল প্রসংগে।should not be declared to have been made without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Cowl may seem fit and proper.” 

 9. It is to be noted that the petitioner physically appeared in the viva voce examination as well as in the medical examination. It was very obvious that no question was raised by the respondents before issuing his appointment letter with regard to the petitioner's gender. Although it Iris been stated in the impugned letter that the petitioner had concealed information at the time of filling an online application and thereby committed fraud. The allegation as alleged appears to the vague and unspecific as it does not disclose the manner in which the .fraud is alleged to have been committed. Furthermore, in our considered view inadvertently a typing mistake as to the gander of the person concerned appears to us a bonofide mistake of the computer operator which does not allow the Authority to cancel the selection of the petitioner as he had appeared in person at the written and viva voce examination as well as in the medical examination. In view of the above fact and circumstances, the impugned order of cancelling the selection of the petitioner vide memo no. 38.01.143.011.019.2003-75 dated 18.06.2016 issued by the respondent No. 3 is without lawful authority.
